==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageSharpCompare&min=ImageSharpCompare&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.ImageSharp.Compare: png, jpg and bmp snapshots are compared pixel by pixel, and
        // pass while the absolute error stays under the threshold.
        // This runs before Initialize(): registration keeps the first comparer registered for each
        // plugin, and Initialize() would otherwise get in first with the default threshold of 5.
        VerifyImageSharpCompare.RegisterComparers(threshold: 5);
        // Marks the plugin initialized, so the trailing InitializePlugins() leaves the registration
        // above alone.
        VerifyImageSharpCompare.Initialize();

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/ImageSharpCompareTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ImageSharpCompare&min=ImageSharpCompare&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using SixLabors.ImageSharp;
using SixLabors.ImageSharp.PixelFormats;

// Verify.ImageSharp.Compare: Compares png, jpg and bmp snapshots pixel by pixel, passing while the absolute error stays under a threshold.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ImageSharp.Compare
// Note: The threshold is an absolute error: lower is stricter, and 5 is the default.
// Verify.ImageHash's threshold is a similarity percentage, where higher is stricter.
// Note: The absolute error grows with the size of the image, so a threshold does not carry over
// between snapshots of different sizes.
// Note: The per test method is named UseImageHash, and the readme and xmldoc describe a
// DifferenceHash algorithm; both are copy and paste from Verify.ImageHash and neither is accurate
// here.
// Note: The package targets net8.0 only.
public class ImageSharpCompareTests
{
    // Nothing in the test names the comparer: it is registered for the png plugin, so every
    // png snapshot in the project is compared this way.
    [Fact]
    public Task CompareImage()
    {
        var stream = NewImage();
        return Verify(stream, "png");
    }

    // Builds a small png in memory, so the samples need no image file checked in. Replace this
    // with VerifyFile("sample.png"), or with whatever produces the image under test.
    static Stream NewImage()
    {
        using var image = new Image<Rgba32>(11, 11)
        {
            [5, 5] = Color.ParseHex("#0000FF").ToPixel<Rgba32>()
        };
        var stream = new MemoryStream();
        image.SaveAsPng(stream);
        stream.Position = 0;
        return stream;
    }
}
